sources.text: We need that when a topic receives the third report from different users, it goes to the review queue as one item, and the moderator is told only once.
The review queue has to load the first page in at most 2 seconds with 500 topics waiting, otherwise the moderators stop using it.
Also, the blog editor must be able to schedule the publication of a post, because today someone has to stay up to publish it at 19:00.
A moderator must be able to dismiss a report that is clearly abusive, and the reporter is told why it was dismissed.

glossary.definition: Ordered list of the reported topics waiting for the decision of a moderator.
A flag raised by a user saying that a topic breaks the rules of the forum.

artifacts.title: Group the reports of a topic
artifacts.statement: When a topic receives the third report, the system shall create one item in the review queue.

story.goal: to see the reports of a topic as one item

acceptance_criteria.given: a topic with two reports from different users
acceptance_criteria.when: a third user reports the topic
acceptance_criteria.then: the system creates one item for the topic in the review queue

acceptance_criteria.given: a topic that is already in the review queue
acceptance_criteria.then: the system increments the counter of the existing item

artifacts.title: Load time of the review queue
artifacts.statement: While 500 topics are waiting, the review queue shall load the first page within 2 seconds.

story.goal: the review queue to open without waiting
story.benefit: I keep using it during peak hours

acceptance_criteria.given: 500 topics waiting in the review queue
acceptance_criteria.then: the first page is displayed within 2 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: 500 topics waiting in the review queue
acceptance_criteria.when: the first page takes more than 2 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs the load time

artifacts.title: Publish a scheduled post
artifacts.statement: When the scheduled time arrives, the system shall publish the post.

story.goal: to schedule the publication of a post
story.benefit: nobody has to stay up to publish it

artifacts.title: Dismiss an abusive report
artifacts.statement: When a moderator dismisses a report as abusive, the system shall tell the reporter the reason.

story.benefit: the review queue only holds real problems

acceptance_criteria.given: a report in the review queue
acceptance_criteria.when: the moderator dismisses it as abusive
acceptance_criteria.then: the system removes the report from the review queue
the system sends the reason to the reporter

evidence.quote: the reporter is told why it was dismissed
evidence.reason: The client asks for the reason to reach the reporter.

document.title: Requirements specification: forum moderation and blog editor

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: This document specifies two parts of the product: the moderation of reported topics in the forum and the scheduling of posts in the blog editor. Both were elicited in the meeting of 2026-03-12 and completed by e-mail on 2026-03-15.

sections.title: Stakeholders and users
sections.text: Forum moderator: decides what happens to reported topics. Blog editor: schedules the publication of posts. Product Owner: approves the final version of the requirements.

sections.title: Use cases
sections.text: UC-01 Review a reported topic: the moderator opens the review queue, picks an item and keeps or removes the topic. UC-02 Schedule a post: the editor writes the post, picks a date and a time and saves it; the system publishes it at that time.

sections.title: Glossary
sections.text: Review queue: ordered list of the reported topics waiting for the decision of a moderator. Report: a flag raised by a user saying that a topic breaks the rules of the forum.
